newsitem.title: USA: Symetrics gets $4 mln in modem deals.
newsitem.headline: Symetrics gets $4 mln in modem deals.

text.p: Symetrics Industries Inc said Thursday it had won contracts worth a total of $4 million to supply a special modem to clients in the public and private sectors.
The company said it got most of the contracts worth a combined total of $3 million from the U.S. Air Force, which already uses the modem, called Improved Data Modems.
A spokesman for Symetrics said it had signed deals worth the remaining amount with the private sector.
Based in Melbourne, Florida, the company makes electronics and telecommunications products.
